decisions.reason: The Air Quality Bricklet was publicly launched as a new capability of the firm's modular system and had its own page, so the firm has invested in it visibly and committed to it, and it fits the announced building-block direction, which makes keeping it likely.

As the Analog In Bricklet 3.0 replacing version 2.0, it is the current core product of an established product line, so dropping it would leave a gap the firm has publicly committed to filling, although a future successor version could eventually replace it.

The CAN bus interface module has been mentioned consistently and extends the modular system into industrial communication, so the development already sunk into it and its fit with the platform argue for continuation.

The CO2 Bricklet has its own page and complements the environmental-sensing line, and with demand for indoor CO2 monitoring after 2020, any weak results could easily be read as temporary, which strongly supports keeping it.
